ask: When someone adds or renames a folder or story on the map, who gets the change?
problem: People cannot add or rename folders and stories where they translate. They must leave for a Manage screen, and most people cannot open it.
found: Real screens from the web app. The map of a story language shows folders and stories but no way to add or rename them. A Bible book can be divided on the map, but only by team leads.
changed: Nothing is built yet. The pictures draw the proposed buttons into the real map: add a story, new folder, rename, and a short sheet to name it.
why: This works like a file explorer: make a folder or file right where you are. The Bible book list gets the same Add a book button. Everything stays in one template, so no new storage is needed.
touches: A change edits the template, so the choice below decides who sees it. Only people who may edit templates would see the buttons.

pictures.label: Before: a story language's map today
After: add, rename and new folder on the map
After: the short sheet to name a story or folder
Before: a Bible language's books today
After: Add a book at the end of the list

options.label: Change the shared template
options.result: Every language using the template gets the folder or story. Each change saves as a new template version.

options.label: Change only this language
options.result: The language gets its own copy on the first change. Other languages keep the old template.

options.label: Ask each time
options.result: The first change asks: everyone, or just this language? Most control, one more question.
